data.name: Poorva
data.long_meaning: Poorva means old, ancient, and first. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'purva' which means 'before' or 'earlier'. This name is often given to a child born before a sibling or as a mark of respect to an elder in the family. It is also a name for the first month of the lunar year in Hindu culture. Poorva is a name that signifies the beginning of something new and the progression towards the future.
